summary:
Senior Power BI Developer and BI Consultant with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise BI solutions for Fortune-500 clients
including UnitedHealth Group, Unilever International, and CIGNA Group across Healthcare, Insurance, FMCG, and Retail
domains. Deep expertise in DAX, Star Schema modelling, Power Platform automation, and Power BI Service administration. Known
for translating complex stakeholder requirements into trusted dashboards that drive strategic decisions — owning full delivery from
requirement gathering through UAT, production deployment, and L2/L3 support.

bullets: Architected an enterprise Power BI reporting suite consolidating multi-source sales, supply chain, and finance data across 3 regions into a single governed BI layer for global stakeholders.
Developed 5 interactive dashboards replacing fragmented Excel-based reporting, reducing manual data consolidation effort by 40–50%.

Implemented Row-Level Security (RLS) and dynamic bookmarks to deliver role-specific, personalised report views for sales, finance, and operations leads — ensuring data confidentiality across departments.
Automated recurring approval workflows using Power Apps (Canvas Apps) and Power Automate, cutting manual coordination time by ~45% across cross-functional teams.
Configured scheduled dataset refresh and gateway connections in Power BI Service, providing stakeholders with always-current data without manual intervention.

Collaborated with healthcare business stakeholders to gather and analyse reporting requirements around patient data, claims, billing, and operational KPIs for one of the largest healthcare companies globally.

Designed and developed 8+ interactive Power BI dashboards tracking patient admissions, discharge trends, claims processing, revenue cycle, and provider performance — adopted across 3 departments within the first month of launch.
Built complex DAX measures including YTD, MTD, QTD time-intelligence functions and performed advanced Power Query transformations (Split, Merge, Append, Pivot, Group By) across large datasets.
Configured On-Premises Data Gateway with scheduled refresh cycles, eliminating manual data pulls and ensuring real-time reporting accuracy for 200+ daily users.
Automated healthcare approval processes using Power Automate integrated with Power BI datasets, reducing manual workflow effort by ~40%.
Managed L2/L3 production support — triaged and resolved RNA tickets in coordination with Snowflake and infrastructure teams while maintaining SLA compliance.
Built an enterprise-level Adherence Dashboard monitoring employee login-logout patterns, break compliance, and productivity benchmarks — enabling real-time adherence tracking for management.
Developed parameterised drill-through and drill-down reports allowing managers to investigate individual adherence anomalies, significantly reducing manual HR audit time.
Created Scorecards, Bookmarks, and QR Codes for reports; published to Power BI Service with gateway configuration and scheduled refresh.
Provided access control for new report users and workspace governance based on BMC tickets and business requirements.
Managed L2/L3 production support — triaged RNA tickets in coordination with Snowflake and infrastructure teams, maintaining SLA compliance.
